met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Bay of Bengal & adjoining Bangladesh coast extending upto 5.8 km above mean sea level persists. Under its influence, a Low Pressure Area is likely to form over North Bay of Bengal & neighbourhood on 10th September, 2026.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continue to pass through Jammu, Dehradun, Pantnagar, Basti, Chapra, Purulia, Digha and thence southeastwards to eastcentral Bay of Bengal.
The trough from Rayalaseema to Gulf of Mannar across Tamil Nadu at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Saurashtra & neighbourhoodbetween 5.8 & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhoodat 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over northwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood between 4.5 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
